summary: DOCKET 68 wave 2: resolve the verifiers’ residuals, then seat wave 2 into the ledger and index3; reproduce

done: W2V-0 #1 and W2V-1 #1 (window bound and floor stated too generally): fixed and computed. T > 0.9097 L/c and the 2.41-3.00 L/c floors are now limited to the two window families actually computed, Reznik cos^2(pi t) with Omega T in [2,40] and the Gaussian at beta = 7. The limit is written in vacuum.py GRADES and the timeline docstring, combine.py (N_VAC history, B-LOCC, ground-check names), W2B-vacuum.md and B-combine.md. New function vacuum.window_free_floor computes the floor from the imported D23 timing (settle.first_transit_times) with no window assumed: t_hold + L/c = 1.50 L/c from the midpoint and 2.00 L/c from one end, with T_window -> 0 allowed. The cost is RRS eq.8's guarantee, which falls as e^-(L/cT)^3 (e^-8 at cT = L/2, e^-64 at L/4). The one required message rests only on R7 Prop.3 and R8 Thm 1 (with no message, local operations raise neither N nor f), so it holds for any state; R9 is not used for RRS windows. Each floor still arrives after light and after a midpoint source (0.50 L/c); no grade moves. New checks: vacuum I3 and I5, I4 (a control), and a combine GROUND check.

W2V-0 #2 and W2V-1 #4 (Proxima b's mass): every site now says minimum mass m sin i = 1.07 +- 0.06 M_earth (Faria 2022 Table C.1 p.17 and p.9, re-READ). The ratio is now a floor: the mass is at least 8.53e21 x the CI threshold. The seat.gate_conjuncts key was renamed, a GROUND check covers it, and W2C-seat.md, the N_S5 text, B-combine.md, W2C-seat.json and W2-combine.json are updated.

W2V-0 #4 (B_x rotation): READ BDSW quant-ph/9604024v2 myself via alphaXiv: p.29 names it ('deterministic bilateral B_x rotation for the twirl T'), and Table 1 p.24 was typed in as BDSW_TABLE1. Computed with bdsw_bx_from_table1: in eq.(40) labels Table 1's B_x is literally 00<->01. Conjugated by the sigma_y of item 5 it is exactly 10<->11, which is swap_post's map, and so is sigma_x B_x (p.58 item 4). Both versions give 0.0045700549, because they differ by a symmetry of eqs.42-43. The typed table was checked against the prose (B_y swaps the high and low bits). Control: B_y gives 0.0029. Only 8 of the 24 possible label maps reproduce 0.00457. A side finding: wave 2's 'search over the six maps that fix 00' actually had two hits, 10<->11 and a 3-cycle. New checks G6, G7 and G8 (G8 a control).

W2V-0 #5 (Brugger 2016): re-READ 1609.09757v3 via alphaXiv. Its model has only a Fe/FeS core, two silicate mantles, high-pressure ice and liquid water, with Earth's parameters (Table 1 p.2), and no C, N or P. Its masses are 1.10-1.46 M_earth with sin i = 1 (p.1, p.3). Every site now reads 'leaves the primitive conjunct unconstrained'. BRUGGER_2016 gains models_C_N_P False, and a GROUND check keeps primitive at None.

W2V-0 #6 (H-MAP wording): now 'the full texts (login wall, not read) may carry each paper's eps convention' in A1, combine's support2 docstring, B-combine sections 8 and 12, the answer section, and W2A-limits.json / W2-combine.json.

W2V-1 #2 (nitrogen): re-READ Porto de Mello, Lyra & Keller 0804.3712v2 via alphaXiv. p.12 says 'The available literature data also suggests that the C, N and O abundance ratios of alpha Cen A are solar', and Fig. 8 p.14 plots N. Their own Table 4 has no N and no P.
